title: Audit log events for A/B experiment lifecycle (create/update/start/stop/rollback)
author: Chloe Martin
release_notes: Adds structured audit log coverage for the A/B experiment lifecycle. Events are emitted from the Console control-plane APIs for create/update/start/stop/rollback and include stable identifiers for export/SIEM correlation. No customer-visible UI changes in this PR.
body: Summary: Adds structured audit log events for the route-level A/B testing experiment lifecycle: create, update, start, stop, and rollback. This is required for beta gating (SRE/security checklist) and to support enterprise auditability + export to SIEM. The events follow the audit logging conventions (actor + resource + action + before/after where applicable) and are designed to be privacy-safe (no prompts, headers, or raw routing inputs). Scope: 1) Emit audit events from the experiment CRUD/start/stop/rollback endpoints. 2) Define canonical action names + payload schema under auditlog/ab_experiment/* with a versioned contract. 3) Add unit/integration tests that validate event emission + redaction rules. 4) Add docs for internal consumers (Support/SecOps) on event fields and examples. Event set: - audit.ab_experiment.created (on create) - audit.ab_experiment.updated (on config edits; includes changed_fields + before/after config digests) - audit.ab_experiment.started (transition draft|paused -> running; includes allocation + variants digests) - audit.ab_experiment.stopped (transition running -> stopped; includes stop_reason) - audit.ab_experiment.rolled_back (rollback workflow invocation; includes rollback_target and guardrail_triggered flag). Required fields (all events): event_id, occurred_at, actor_type (user|api_key|service), actor_id, org_id, project_id, environment (prod|staging), region (control-plane region), ip (if actor_type=user), user_agent (if actor_type=user), request_id, resource_type=ab_experiment, resource_id (experiment_id), resource_name (human-readable), route_id, route_path (normalized), action, outcome (success|failure), schema_version. Optional fields: previous_state/new_state, changed_fields (allowlist), before_config_digest/after_config_digest (sha256 of canonical JSON), allocation (e.g. 90/10), variants (ids + model ref digests), guardrail_triggered, rollback_reason, error_code. Design notes: - Redaction: We only log normalized route_path (e.g. /v1/chat/completions) and route_id; we do not include raw eligibility rules that could embed customer identifiers beyond org/project ids already present. - Digests: We log sha256 digests of canonicalized config JSON instead of embedding full config in audit logs to keep payload size stable and reduce accidental leakage. Console can still reconstruct config history via the experiment config store + audit event correlation. - Failure outcomes: For rejected updates (validation errors / RBAC), we still emit an audit event with outcome=failure and a coarse error_code (no detailed validation payload). - Consistency: Uses AuditLogger.emit() with an explicit allowlist of keys; tests assert that disallowed keys (e.g. prompt_set_id, header_hash_key, api_key plaintext) never appear. - Correlation: request_id is plumbed from the API gateway into the Console backend and included in the audit event for cross-system tracing. Related: ENG-2843 (CRUD APIs), ENG-2847 (security review), ADR-0188 (exposure logging privacy) for adjacent privacy constraints; this PR only covers audit logs for config lifecycle, not exposure events. Testing: - Unit tests for each endpoint path (create/update/start/stop/rollback) asserting event action, required fields, and digests. - Integration test exercising rollback endpoint to ensure guardrail_triggered is populated when invoked via guardrail evaluator hook. Rollout: Behind the existing audit logging sink; no feature flag. Safe to merge before Console UI ships. Audit export pipeline already supports these event types (schema_versioned).
commits: auditlog: define ab_experiment event actions + schema v1
console: emit audit events from experiment create/update handlers
console: emit audit events from start/stop/rollback transitions
auditlog: add canonical JSON digest helper + allowlist enforcement
tests: unit coverage for audit emission + redaction assertions
docs: add internal audit event reference + example payloads
review_conversation: Marcus Lin: Can we ensure we never log the full variants config? Some customers embed internal identifiers in model alias fields. Suggest logging digests only + strict allowlist.

Chloe Martin (author): Good call. Updated to store before/after digests only (sha256 of canonical JSON) and added an explicit key allowlist. Added a regression test that fails if `variants[*].metadata` is present in the audit payload.
Naomi Feldman: For failure cases, we still need an audit trail. Please emit outcome=failure for RBAC/validation rejects but avoid detailed error messages that could leak config.
Chloe Martin (author): Implemented. We emit the action with outcome=failure + coarse error_code (RBAC_DENIED, VALIDATION_FAILED, NOT_FOUND). No validation details included.
Dylan Brooks: Request_id propagation looks new—does this depend on any gateway changes? I want to avoid a partial rollout where it’s null everywhere.
Chloe Martin (author): It’s optional; we default to a generated request_id if missing. When gateway propagation lands (PR 18371) it will populate end-to-end, but this won’t block.
Ethan Park: Please align action names with existing audit conventions (resource.action) and add schema_version to payload for forward compatibility.
Chloe Martin (author): Renamed actions to audit.ab_experiment.* and added schema_version=v1 across all events. Docs updated with examples.
Marcus Lin: Final nit: remove user_agent for service actors; it’s noisy and sometimes includes internal env details.
Chloe Martin (author): Done—user_agent only for actor_type=user. Added test coverage.
Marcus Lin: Approved after last push.
